verdict_text: NO. The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6` and therefore removes head 6 instead of head 5, violating the "remove head 5 (heads are numbered from 0)" clause of Required result. Concretely, `query_key_value.weight`/`.bias` keep rows `0..4607` and `5376..6143` rather than the required `0..3839` and `4608..6143` (clauses 1 and 2), and `attention.dense.weight` keeps columns `0..1535` and `1792..2047` rather than `0..1279` and `1536..2047` (clause 3). The required checks all still pass because they only test shapes, which are identical for any dropped head, so the wrong values are written silently and the artifact fails the bit-exact grading.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
